name: Beyond the sun

categories.label: Private technologies (from card bonuses)
categories.hint: Level II = 2 VP, Level III = 3 VP.

categories.label: Level IV technologies
categories.hint: Sum of the VP specified on your Level IV technology cards.

categories.label: Automation track
categories.hint: Add all VP showing up to your level reached; each level beyond 7 gives 1 VP.

categories.label: Colonized systems
categories.labelVi: Hệ sao đã thuộc địa hóa
categories.hint: VP printed at the bottom of each System card you colonized.

categories.label: Uncolonized outpost discs
categories.labelVi: Đĩa tiền đồn chưa thuộc địa
categories.hint: 1 VP per outpost disc on System cards or Shipyard Systems.

categories.label: Non-controllable locations (Sol, Deep Space)
categories.labelVi: Vị trí không chiếm được (Sol, Deep Space)
categories.hint: 1 VP each for the faction(s) with the highest military power there (ties all score).

categories.label: Event cards giving VP
categories.hint: VP from Event cards (near Achievement cards or attached to locations/factions).

categories.label: Achievements
categories.hint: VP of the slot each of your discs sits in.

categories.label: Remaining Food and Ore production discs (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Đĩa sản xuất Food và Ore còn lại (phân định hòa)
categories.hint: Fewest remaining = highest combined production level.

categories.label: Remaining Population cubes (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Khối dân số còn lại (phân định hòa)

categories.label: Remaining Ore crystals (tiebreak)
categories.labelVi: Tinh thể Ore còn lại (phân định hòa)

tiebreakers.description: Fewest remaining Food and Ore production discs on the faction mat (highest combined production level)
If still tied, factions jointly rule the galaxy (shared victory).

notes: family: area-majority. Game end is triggered when 4 Achievement discs (3 in 2-3 player games) are on Achievement cards; finish the round, then one full final round (Achievements can still be claimed). Solo/automa and expansions (Leaders of the New Dawn) not modelled. Tech and Event VP values vary per card, hence repeating inputs.
